lead.question: 朋友摔下楼梯、站不起来——你会怎么问他伤着没有，又怎么把「医生说他马上就来」这句话转述给别人？
lead.warmup: 先别看课文。想象你看到有人滑倒摔下楼梯：先问 What's the matter?（怎么了），再问 Have you hurt yourself?（伤着自己了吗）。伤者回答时常常套在 I think that ... / I'm afraid that ... 这样的框架里。而第三者转述时要用「动词 + that 从句」：He says that he ...。本课 Andy 滑倒摔伤背，Lucy 一边帮忙一边打电话叫医生。留意每一句 that 从句——口语里 that 还可以省略。
goals: 能用 What's the matter? / Have you hurt yourself? 询问事故与伤情
掌握 say / think / be afraid / be sure + (that) 从句的宾语从句结构
能用 He says that he ... 转述别人的话（引述动词是现在时时从句时态不变）
掌握 had better + 动词原形、at once、an X-ray 等表达
lead.summary: 第 99 课 Andy 滑倒摔下楼梯，认为自己摔伤了背、站不起来；Lucy 建议最好请医生看看，打电话给 Dr Carter，医生说马上就来，Lucy 还肯定 Andy 需要拍 X 光。第 100 课集中操练宾语从句：把 He feels ill. 之类的话转述成 He says that he feels ill.，人称随之变化，时态保持一致。
lead.tips: ① 宾语从句用 that 引导，口语中常省略：I think (that) I've hurt my back.；② afraid/sure/sorry/glad 这类表示情感的形容词后也能接 that 从句；③ 引述动词是现在时（says/thinks）时，从句时态与原话相同；④ had better do sth「最好做……」，后接动词原形；⑤ hurt 的过去式、过去分词都是 hurt；fall 是 fell—fallen；⑥ get up 既是「起床」也可指「站起来」。

questions.q: Must Andy go to see the doctor?
questions.a: Yes, he must. Lucy thinks that the doctor had better see him, and she telephones Dr Carter.
questions.aZh: 需要。露西觉得最好请医生来看看，于是她给卡特医生打了电话。
questions.hint: 听 I think that the doctor had better see you. I'll telephone Dr Carter.

questions.aZh: 他滑了一跤，从楼梯上摔了下来。
questions.hint: Andy 的第一句回答：I slipped and ...

questions.q: What does Andy think he has hurt?
questions.zh: 安迪认为自己伤到了哪里？
questions.a: He thinks that he has hurt his back.
questions.aZh: 他觉得自己把背摔伤了。
questions.hint: I think that I've hurt my ...

questions.a: The doctor says that he will come at once.
questions.hint: Lucy 打完电话后的转述。

questions.q: Why can we drop 'that' and say 'I think I've hurt my back' in speech?
questions.zh: 为什么口语里可以说 I think I've hurt my back，把 that 省掉？
questions.a: That introduces the object clause after verbs like think, say, believe. In everyday speech that is very often omitted, especially after common verbs and after afraid/sure.
questions.aZh: that 引导 think/say/believe 等动词后的宾语从句；口语（尤其在常用动词和 afraid/sure 之后）经常把它省掉，意思不变。
questions.hint: 想一想英文歌词、日常对话里听到的是 I think (that) ... 里的哪个版本。

questions.q: 把 'I feel ill.' 转述给别人：He says that ...
questions.zh: 第 100 课操练：用 He/She says that ... 转述别人的话，注意人称变化。
questions.a: He says that he feels ill.
questions.hint: 引述动词是现在时，从句时态不变，只改人称。

lines.speaker: ANDY
lines.note: 网站文本误作 Ted/Pat，正版教材人物为 Andy/Lucy，按参考译文与听力问题（Must Andy go to see the doctor?）校正。

lines.speaker: ANDY
lines.zh: 我滑了一跤，从楼梯上摔下来了。

lines.speaker: ANDY
lines.en: Yes, I have. I think that I've hurt my back.
lines.zh: 是啊，摔伤了。我想我把背摔坏了。

lines.speaker: LUCY
lines.en: Try and stand up. Can you stand up? Here. Let me help you.
lines.zh: 试试站起来。你能站起来吗？来，让我帮你。

lines.en: I think that the doctor had better see you. I'll telephone Dr Carter.
lines.zh: 我想最好请医生来给你看一下。我去给卡特医生打电话。

lines.speaker: LUCY
lines.en: The doctor says that he will come at once. I'm sure that you need an X-ray, Andy.
lines.zh: 医生说他马上就来。安迪，我看你需要做一次X光透视。

drill.q: He/She/They say(s) that ___ .（把原话 I feel ill. 之类转述出来）
drill.zh: 他/她/他们说……（引述动词是现在时，从句时态不变，只改人称）
answers: He says that he feels ill.
She says that she has got a headache.
They say that they are thirsty.

exercises.q: 汉译英：我想我把背摔坏了。
exercises.a: I think that I've hurt my back.
exercises.note: 宾语从句用 that 引导，口语可省：I think I've hurt my back.

exercises.q: 汉译英：恐怕我站不起来。
exercises.a: I'm afraid that I can't get up.
She says that she is cold.
exercises.note: 引述动词现在时，从句时态不变，I 改 she、am 改 is。

exercises.q: 改错：He says that he feel ill.
exercises.a: He says that he feels ill.
exercises.note: 从句主语 he 是第三人称单数，动词要加 -s。

exercises.q: 汉译英：医生说他马上就来。
exercises.a: The doctor says that he will come at once.

exercises.q: 汉译英：我看你需要做一次X光透视。
exercises.a: I'm sure that you need an X-ray.
exercises.note: be sure that ... 肯定、确信。

exercises.q: 用 had better 补全：你最好去请医生看看。
exercises.a: You had better see a doctor.
exercises.note: had better + 动词原形，后不加 to。

quiz.q: — Have you hurt yourself? — Yes, ____. I've hurt my back.
quiz.zh: 「你摔伤了没有？」的肯定简略回答是：
quiz.note: Have you ...? 的简略回答用 have：Yes, I have.

quiz.q: Fall 的过去式和过去分词是：
「医生说他马上就来」正确的是：
options: The doctor says that he will come at once.
The doctor says that he will come once.
The doctor say that he will come at once.
The doctor says that he comes at once.
quiz.note: at once 是固定短语「立即」；says 要有 -s。

quiz.q: I'm afraid that I can't get up. 中 that 从句：
options: 作 afraid 的宾语，口语可省 that
quiz.note: afraid 后接 that 宾语从句，口语常省 that。

quiz.q: 转述 'I want a haircut.'（他说）应是：
options: He says that he wants a haircut.
He says that I want a haircut.
He says that he want a haircut.
He says that he wanted a haircut.
quiz.note: 引述动词是现在时，时态不变、人称 I→he、want→wants。

quiz.q: Had better 后面的动词形式是：
quiz.note: had better do sth，不用 had better to do。

grammar.title: 宾语从句（Object Clause，that 引导）
grammar.structure: 主语 + say / think / believe / hope / know / understand + (that) + 从句
grammar.definition: 宾语从句在句中作宾语，一般用 that 引导，口语中 that 经常省略。
grammar.usage: 引述别人刚说过的话时，引述动词常用现在时（says/thinks），从句时态与原话相同。

examples.en: She says that she is cold.
He thinks that he needs an X-ray.

grammar.title: be afraid that / be sure that
grammar.structure: be + afraid / sure / sorry / glad + (that) + 从句
grammar.definition: 某些描写情感的形容词之后也可以接 that 从句，表示「恐怕……/肯定……」。
grammar.usage: I'm afraid that I can't get up. / I'm sure that you need an X-ray.

examples.en: I'm sure that you need an X-ray.
I am sorry that you are ill.
examples.zh: 听到你生病了我很难过。

grammar.title: had better + 动词原形
grammar.structure: 主语 + had better (not) + 动词原形
grammar.definition: had better 表示「最好（不要）做某事」，是提出建议的常用说法，后接动词原形，不加 to。
grammar.usage: The doctor had better see you. 最好请医生来看看你。

examples.en: I think that the doctor had better see you.
examples.zh: 我想最好请医生来给你看一下。

examples.en: You had better stay at home today.

phrases.usage: 怎么了？出什么事了？（询问状况）

examples.en: What's the matter, Andy?

phrases.usage: 站起来 / 起床（get up 也可指站起来）

examples.en: Try and stand up. Can you stand up?
examples.zh: 试试站起来。你能站起来吗？

examples.en: The doctor says that he will come at once.

phrases.usage: 最好……（建议，后接动词原形）

examples.en: I think that the doctor had better see you.
examples.zh: 我想最好请医生来给你看一下。

examples.en: Here. Let me help you.

phrases.usage: 口语中表示歉意或婉拒的开场

examples.en: I'm sorry, Lucy. I'm afraid that I can't get up.
examples.zh: 对不起，露西，恐怕我站不起来。
